crash_root_cause: Renode NVIC model threw (HandlePriorityWrite -> ExceptionSimpleArray.set_Item, NVIC.cs:1871/3023) during the run, before any results. Cause: an NVIC store with an IRQ index outside the modelled range. Two sources: (1) the direct target nvic_disable_irq_55e262 was fuzzed with wild irq values, so ICER[irq>>5] (base 0xe000e180) reached the priority-register region (>=0xe000e400) when irq>=~5120; (2) hal_uart_stop read g2_uart_channels[uart].module from a poison-seeded (0xffffffff) channel table and passed module+15 to the NVIC.
body_identity_proof: Disasm of stock 0x55e262 == our C nvic_disable_irq_55e262 byte-for-byte: SXTH; CMP #0/BMI (irq>=0); MOVS r2,#1; AND r1,r0,#0x1f; LSL r2,r1; LDR ICER base 0xe000e180; SXTH; LSR r0,#5; STR.W r2,[r1,r0,lsl#2]; DSB; ISB; BX. This is CMSIS NVIC_DisableIRQ. No C-vs-stock behaviour difference exists; the crash is purely Renode's NVIC model rejecting out-of-range stores that both identical bodies perform.
fix: Harness-only, no firmware change. (a) ARG_DOMAIN[(nvic_disable_irq_55e262,0)] bounded to valid IRQs [0,1,2,3,14,15,16,17,18,19,31,32,33,47,48,63,64] (all keep ICER[irq>>5] in 0xe000e180 region). (b) PRELOAD_WORDS['uartstop'] seeds g2_uart_channels[0..3] with module=0..3, handle=NULL (stock am_hal_uart returns INVALID_HANDLE cleanly), pins->valid scratch pin record at 0x20250900.
irq_bound_evidence: Stock caller box_uart_mgr.c (drivers/power/box-detect) calls hal_uart_stop_55e75a(BOX_UART) and hal_uart_tx_flush_55e956(BOX_UART) with BOX_UART=2 (line 18) => IRQ = module+15 = 17. The board has 4 UART channels, modules 0..3 => real IRQs 15..18. The seeded modules (0..3) and the direct-target IRQ domain (0..64) cover the stock caller's real IRQs and stay within the modelled ICER range. No diff is hidden: the direct-target body is byte-identical to stock, so equivalence holds across the full input space structurally; the domain only keeps the emulator's NVIC model from throwing.
mandate_note: Per the 5:47 PM mandate: this is a proven harness/emulator artifact (NVIC model throw), not a masked C-vs-stock diff; the C body is byte-identical to stock by disassembly.
